result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback 90-day period for Deliverables and retains repair, replacement, re-performance, and refund remedies, but it does not provide the required 30-day Services warranty period or expressly warrant compliance with laws and absence of malicious code. Section 19.3 cannot be assumed to supply those missing protections because its text is not provided. Moreover, stating that the period does not limit “any other remedy available to Customer” unnecessarily broadens the negotiated remedy structure in Section 19.4 and may make the Services warranty effectively unlimited. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies.
